title: 第7章 不争馒头争口气

第一卷 恰同学少年 第七章 不争馒头争口气

虽然苏林不知道自己为什么突然之间拥有了暂停时间的能力，但是既然有了这么神奇的能力，苏林怎么能够不好好利用一番。利用这个能力，改变自己的命运，改变家人的处境，出人头地，这些从前的虚谈，现在完全都有可能实现了。

“只要我心里一想暂停时间，周围的时间都会暂停住，只有我可以不受影响的活动。而我能够暂停时间的长短，取决于这些数字的大小，现在……我还拥有一百零一秒的时间暂停。”

坐在沙发上，苏林凝视着自己视线右上角的鲜红色数字“101”，“不过这时间要如何获得呢？貌似今天是和竹姐姐在浴缸时候，亲密的接触使得它疯涨的……难道说，这数字需要和女性亲密接触才会增加的么？”

苏林虽然现在的学习成绩不拔尖，但是不代表他笨，相反，苏林可机灵了，什么东西都经不起人的琢磨，坐在沙发上，稍微那么一琢磨，苏林心里面也大致有了自己的谱儿，对于这个莫名其妙带来的能力，心里面就有数了。

晚上六点十分，苏林的父亲苏国荣拖着疲惫的身体打开了家门，一脸的疲倦，刚刚进家门，就往沙发上一坐，双眼一眯，掏出烟盒打火机，抽起了烟来。

看着父亲每次这么劳累，其实苏林的心里也不好过。父亲苏国荣本来是退伍军人，只是军转干的时候运气不好，没有在事业单位站住脚，结果就自己找了一家运输公司开货车。工资不高，才两三千一个月，而且当过兵的苏国荣为人比较直，经常不会来事儿，所以许多暗地里能够得到的好处没能得到，还得罪了不少人，做了十几年了，也才混得一个运输一组组长的虚职。

苏国荣可能是太累了，头也没抬一下看自己的儿子，只是微微点了点头，用鼻音哼了一声，然后也不想多说话，就那么怔怔的抽着烟，发呆思考着。

其实大部分的男人都是如此，在外工作压力大，身心疲累，回到家里来，唯一的休息放松消遣无非就是抽上一根烟，再发上一会儿呆，看看妻儿，便觉得自己的辛苦也算是有了着落。

父亲的态度一向如此，苏林也没有太在意，但是当晚饭开动的时候，一向沉默寡言的父亲今天却叹了一口气，停了筷子，抬起头，盯着苏林几秒钟，然后说道：“小林，马上就要高考了。”

“嗯……是，爸，还有二十多天……”

只是短短的九个字，但是苏林却从父亲的语气当中听出了更多的内容，看来父亲最近也是替自己未来的发展道路而发愁了。

“今年的高考，你，你二舅的女儿灵灵，还有你三叔的儿子小翼，你们三个都是今年考。上高中以前，你的成绩最好，可是现在……诶……”

又是一声叹气，苏国荣也没有再说下去，自己给自己倒了一杯白的，一口闷了，滋了一声，虽然没有再多说什么，但是却已经给了苏林心里沉甸甸的压力。

苏林的父亲就是这样的人，身上拥有的是军人那种最坚毅和淳朴的品质，话不多，但是他说的每一句话，对于苏林来说，意义都非凡。

“爸，我知道了。我一定会努力，考上一个好的大学，替你们争光。”

低着头，苏林内心充满着愧疚，咬着牙，心里面却是暗暗发誓，高考一定要考好，将来也要一定出人头地。不争馒头也要争这口气。

“知道？你这小兔崽子知道个屁。你要是知道，成绩还会这么差？老娘是打了打了，骂也骂过了，以后你自己的路是你自己选的，考不上就去打工。”

一直没说话的苏母却是十分直接，这三年来她殚精竭虑地想让苏林能够振作起来，可是苏林的学习成绩就是上不去，现在就剩下最后的二十多天了，她已经完全不抱希望了。三年都没有改变的事，难道这最后的二十多天还能够有转机不成？

破天荒的，今天苏林没有和母亲顶嘴，父母的辛苦，其实他也看在眼里，记在心上，只是少年的叛逆，年少的轻狂，让他稀里糊涂地过了这三年。还好，现在还不算晚，拥有了暂停时间的能力，苏林相信，自己绝对能够走过高考这一条千军万马的独木桥，走出一个辉煌的未来。

接下来的晚饭时间都是在沉闷当中度过，苏林匆匆扒了几口饭就回自己的房间看书去了。而在苏林下桌以后，苏父和苏母却又继续谈论起苏林的问题来了。

“诶，老苏，你倒是想想办法，我们家小林这样，恐怕是真的考不上好的大学了，三本我们家也供不起，难不成到时候真让我们家小林去打工？”

可怜天下父母心，虽然刘爱珍口头上对苏林严厉，但是心里面还是对自己的儿子宝贝得紧，哪里舍得让苏林去吃苦打工。

“那有什么办法，考不上大学，没有文凭，不去打工，难道一直窝在家里？”

撮了一口烟，轻轻吐了烟雾，苏国荣顿了顿，然后说道，“实在不行，我就让大哥找找门路，三本上不起，去一个大专学点手艺回来，也有一碗饭吃。”

五月中旬的建安市，也已经有了蒸笼的趋势，热得不行。到了晚上八点以后，街坊邻里的没事儿都坐到了院子外面，大树底下，说话乘凉。

苏林家的院子外面，此时那些七大姑八大婆正叽叽喳喳地讨论着什么。虽然第二天就是最后一次模拟考试了，但是屋子里面实在是太热了，苏林可呆不下去，就捧着书也坐到了院子里来看。

刚好院子大树下有路灯，又凉快又明亮，唯一不好的就是蚊虫也多，所以苏林在身上多喷了一点花露水。

“哎……爱珍，你们家小林学习挺用功的嘛！在市一中上学，学习成绩肯定不错吧！今年高考肯定能考上重点大学，你们夫妻俩也算熬出头了。”

说着说着，就有街坊把话题往这方面引。而苏林母亲刘爱珍听了这话，脸上尴尬了一下，叹了口气，解释道：“我家小林成绩不好，能不能考上大学都俩说，更不用奢望重点大学了。”

“不至于吧！我记得你们家小林初中时候的成绩挺好的呀！要不然也考不上市一中了……”

有的偏远一点的街坊对苏林的印象还停留在他考上市一中风光的时候，可是现在，苏林的成绩一落千丈，哪里还是当初那个街坊邻里亲戚朋友都夸赞的好少年。

“哼！就他们家苏林那成绩，能够考上一个二本学校就很不错了……还重点大学，做梦去吧！”

一阵讥讽，苏林皱了皱眉头，朝着这个声音的主人看去。

那得意地笑声，苏林知道这唐忠旺，和自己住在一个街道，今年也是高三，同样也在市一中读书。不过从小学到初中，他的成绩都不如苏林，所以一直以来都视苏林为大敌，自从苏林高中颓废以后，唐忠旺可不止一次在这样的公众场合讥讽他。

“忠旺，怎么说话的？以前小林的成绩可比你更好，虽然你现在的成绩再努努力就够得到一本了，但是也不能够骄傲，要再接再厉知道么？”

唐忠旺的父亲唐良元训斥了他一声，其实明着是训斥，其实炫耀的成分更多。虽然唐忠旺的成绩在市一中也只能够算是中等偏上，但是有能力可能考上一本大学，就足够唐良元骄傲自豪的了。

“知道了，爸。我会努力的，明天就是我们一中最后一次的摸底考试，我最近复习的状态很好，肯定能再进一步，争取杀入年段前一百名，这样上一本线就稳稳的了。我可不会像有些人那样，成天吊儿郎当的，不学习就知道玩，以后只能够去打工了。”

“知道就好，忠旺，你比同龄人懂事多了，爸妈也放心。”

唐良元父子俩的对话，明显就是说给苏林和苏林的父母听的。而苏林的父母明知道对方是在讥讽苏林，却也没办法，还要强装着笑容恭喜道：“你们家忠旺就是比我们家小林有出息，我们家小林应该像忠旺学习。”

说着，苏母还扯了扯苏林，道：“小林，你和忠旺都在市一中，虽然不同班，复习的资料应该都一样，还有二十多天高考。忠旺的成绩比你好多了，你有不懂的，晚上回来就多问问他……”

苏母这话还没有说完，谁知道唐忠旺却突然打断苏母，插嘴一句：“爸，现在也不怎么热了，我回房间复习了，我可没有什么闲工夫浪费在什么阿猫阿狗身上，自己时间都来不及，多复习一点，高考可能就多几分。”

说完，唐忠旺起身就要回自己的房间了。但是他的这句话却是腾的一下将苏林给惹火了，你唐忠旺讥讽我苏林我没有和你计较，我成绩现在的确不如你，你是有骄傲的资本，但是我爸妈这么低声下气的了，你却一点都不给我妈面子，还说什么阿猫阿狗。是可忍孰不可忍，苏林腾地一下站了起来：“唐忠旺，**给我站住。你说谁是阿猫阿狗……”

“我说的是谁，谁的心里有数，学习不好，底气还这么大。呵呵，声音还挺大的，正好以后是个打工的好材料。”

唐忠旺连头都没有回，似乎很是不屑和苏林争论，讥笑了几声，道，“嗓门大算什么本事，苏林，你有种在明天的模拟考试成绩上超过我。不过依我看，恐怕要等下辈子了。”

本来苏林被父母说来已经比较沉重，又被唐忠旺这么讥讽，哪里还沉得住气，当即站了起来就要上前教训唐忠旺一阵。

却不料，苏林的父亲却严厉地训了苏林一句，“给我回房间看书去，瞎胡闹什么，成绩比不过别人，还有理了？”

苏林最怕的就是自己的父亲，不听谁的话也不能不听自己父亲的话，于是也只好硬生生把这口气忍了下来，看着唐忠旺那得意的样子，牙恨得痒痒的。

心中默念一声，苏林暂停了时间，然后飞速上前，在唐忠旺的小腿肚子上狠狠地踹了一脚，然后回到自己的位置上，解除时间暂停。

时间恢复，唐忠旺猛然间觉得自己的小腿肚子似乎被踹了一下，剧烈地疼痛让他一个踉跄就摔在了地上。

唐忠旺的父亲一阵紧张，赶紧拉起了自己的儿子。

“不知道，爸，好像小腿被人踹了一下的感觉……可能是抽筋了……”唐忠旺看了看苏林，总觉得是苏林在捣鬼，可是苏林距离自己可有好几步远，所以他见苏林现在幸灾乐祸的样子，也只能够把气咽了下去。

“这就叫做恶人有恶报，让你得意。”

苏林还不忘耍耍嘴皮子，这一脚踹的，心里才解气了那么一点。

而就在这时，叶星竹的母亲梁桂珠从屋子里走到院子，手里还拿着一个书包，对苏林道：“小林，这是你的书包吧？怎么在我们家的沙发上？好像今天傍晚你没来我们家啊？”

“糟了！先前溜出来的时候，怎么把书包给忘了……”

Volume 1: The Classmate Boy Chapter 7: Don’t fight over the steamed buns to fight for the breath

Although Su Lin didn't know why he suddenly had the ability to pause time, since he had such a magical ability, how could Su Lin not make good use of it.Use this ability to change your own destiny, change the situation of your family, and get ahead. These former empty talk are now completely possible.

"As long as I think about pausing time, the time around me will be paused. Only my activities can be unaffected. And the length of time I can pause depends on the size of these numbers. Now... I still have one hundred and one seconds of time pause."

Sitting on the sofa, Su Lin stared at the bright red number "101" in the upper right corner of his sight, "But how to get this time? It seems that today when I was in the bathtub with Sister Zhu, the intimate contact caused it to skyrocket... Could it be said that this number needs to be in close contact with women to increase?"

Although Su Lin's current academic performance is not top-notch, it does not mean that he is stupid. On the contrary, Su Lin is smart and can't withstand anyone's thinking. Sitting on the sofa, after thinking about it for a while, Su Lin roughly has his own score in his heart, and he has an idea of ​​this inexplicable ability.

At 6:10 p.m., Su Lin's father, Su Guorong, dragged his tired body and opened the door of his house. He looked tired. As soon as he entered the house, he sat on the sofa, narrowed his eyes, took out his cigarette case lighter, and started smoking.

Seeing his father working so hard every time, Su Lin actually felt uncomfortable.His father, Su Guorong, was originally a veteran. However, he was unlucky when he switched jobs and failed to gain a foothold in a public institution. As a result, he found a transportation company to drive a truck.The salary was not high, only two to three thousand a month, and Su Guorong, who had been a soldier, was relatively straightforward and often did not get into trouble, so he failed to get many benefits that could be obtained secretly, and offended many people. After working for more than ten years, he only managed to get a false position as the leader of a transportation team.

Su Guorong might be too tired, so he didn't even raise his head to look at his son. He just nodded slightly and snorted in a nasal voice. Then he didn't want to say anything more. He just smoked a cigarette and thought in a daze.

In fact, most men are like this. They work under great pressure outside and are exhausted physically and mentally. When they come home, the only way to relax and have fun is to smoke a cigarette, hang out for a while, look at their wives and children, and feel that their hard work has finally paid off.

His father's attitude had always been this way, and Su Lin didn't pay much attention to it. However, when dinner started, his usually taciturn father sighed, stopped using his chopsticks, raised his head, stared at Su Lin for a few seconds, and then said, "Xiao Lin, the college entrance examination is about to take place."

"Well...yes, Dad, there are still more than twenty days..."

It was only nine short words, but Sulin heard more content from his father's tone. It seemed that his father had also been worried about his future development path recently.

"You, your second uncle's daughter Lingling, and your third uncle's son Xiaoyi are all taking the college entrance examination this year. Before you entered high school, you had the best grades, but now... eh..."

With another sigh, Su Guorong didn't say any more. He poured himself a glass of white wine, took a sip and let out a sigh. Although he didn't say anything more, it already put a heavy pressure on Su Lin's heart.

Su Lin's father was such a person. He had the most perseverance and simplicity of a soldier. He didn't talk much, but every word he said was of extraordinary significance to Su Lin.

"Dad, I understand. I will definitely work hard to get into a good university and bring glory to you."

Lowering his head, Su Lin was filled with guilt. He gritted his teeth, but secretly vowed in his heart that he must do well in the college entrance examination and stand out in the future.Even if you don't fight for steamed buns, you have to fight for this breath.

"You know? You little bastard knows nothing. If you knew, would your grades be so bad? I have been beaten and scolded. From now on, you will choose your own path. If you don't pass the exam, you will go to work."

Su's mother, who has been silent, is very direct. In the past three years, she has tried her best to cheer Su Lin up, but Su Lin's academic performance has not improved. Now there are only the last twenty days left, and she has completely given up hope.Things haven't changed in three years, can there be any improvement in the last twenty days?

For the first time, Su Lin didn't talk back to his mother today. In fact, he saw and remembered his parents' hard work. It was just his youthful rebellion and frivolity that made him spend the past three years in a daze.Fortunately, it's not too late now. With the ability to pause time, Su Lin believes that he can definitely cross the single-plank bridge of the college entrance examination and walk out of a brilliant future.

The rest of the dinner time was spent in dullness. Su Lin hurriedly took a few bites of food and then went back to his room to read.After Su Lin left the table, Su's father and Su's mother continued to talk about Su Lin's problem.

"Hey, Lao Su, you should think of a way. If our Xiaolin is like this, I'm afraid he really won't be able to get into a good university. Our family can't afford three exams. Is it possible that our Xiaolin will really have to work part-time?"

Poor parents in the world. Although Liu Aizhen was verbally strict with Su Lin, she was still very protective of her son in her heart. She was not willing to let Su Lin work hard.

"Then what can you do? If you can't go to college, don't have a diploma, and don't go to work, can you stay at home all the time?"

After taking a puff of cigarette and blowing out the smoke, Su Guorong paused and then said, "If it doesn't work out, I'll ask my eldest brother to find a way out. If I can't afford three degrees, I can go to a college to learn some crafts and come back with a bowl of food."

In Jian'an City in mid-May, there is also a trend of steamers, and it is extremely hot.After eight o'clock in the evening, all the neighbors sat outside the yard, under the big trees, chatting and enjoying the shade.

Outside the courtyard of Sulin's house, the seven aunts and eight grandma were chattering about something.Although the next day was the last mock exam, it was too hot inside the room. Su Lin couldn't stay any longer, so he sat in the yard and read the book.

There happened to be a street lamp under the big tree in the yard, which was cool and bright. The only disadvantage was that there were many mosquitoes, so Su Lin sprayed a little more toilet water on his body.

"Hey... Aizhen, your Xiaolin studies very hard! He goes to the No. 1 Middle School in the city, and his academic performance must be good! He will definitely be admitted to a key university in the college entrance examination this year, and you and your wife can be considered successful."

As we talked, some neighbors brought the topic to this aspect.When Su Lin's mother Liu Aizhen heard this, she looked embarrassed, sighed, and explained: "My Xiaolin's grades are not good. It's hard to decide whether he can get into university, let alone a key university."

"No way! I remember your Xiaolin's grades in junior high school were pretty good! Otherwise, he wouldn't have been able to pass the No. 1 high school..."

Some distant neighbors still had an impression of Su Lin from the time when he was admitted to the first grade of Shanghai Municipal Government. But now, Su Lin's grades have plummeted, and he is still the good boy that his neighbors, relatives and friends praised.

"Hmph! With Su Lin's grades, it would be great to be admitted to a second-tier school... or even a key university, just dream!"

After a burst of sarcasm, Su Lin frowned and looked at the owner of the voice.

With that proud laugh, Su Lin knew that Tang Zhongwang lived on the same street as him. He was also a senior in high school this year and was also studying in No. 1 Middle School.However, from elementary school to junior high school, his grades were not as good as Su Lin's, so he has always regarded Su Lin as his enemy. Since Su Lin's high school decadence, Tang Zhongwang has ridiculed him in such public places more than once.

"Zhongwang, what are you talking about? Xiaolin's grades were better than yours in the past. Although your current grades are enough to get a copy no matter how hard you work, you can't be proud. You have to keep up your efforts, you know?"

Tang Zhongwang's father, Tang Liangyuan, scolded him. In fact, it was clearly a scolding, but it was more of a show off.Although Tang Zhongwang's grades can only be regarded as above average in the city's No. 1 Middle School, Tang Liangyuan is proud that he has the ability to possibly be admitted to a university.

"I know, Dad. I will work hard. Tomorrow is the last test for our No. 1 Middle School. I have been in good review mode recently. I will definitely go one step further and strive to be among the top 100 in my year. This way, I will be stable in the first line. I will not be like some people who idle around all day long and only know how to play without studying. I will only be able to work part-time in the future."

"It's good to know, Zhongwang, you are much more sensible than your peers, and your parents can rest assured."

The conversation between Tang Liangyuan and his son was obviously for Su Lin and Su Lin's parents.Su Lin's parents knew clearly that the other party was ridiculing Su Lin, but they had no choice but to pretend to smile and congratulate: "Your Zhongwang is more promising than our Xiao Lin. Our Xiao Lin should learn from Zhong Wang."

After saying that, Mother Su teased Su Lin and said, "Xiao Lin, you and Zhong Wang are both in No. 1 Middle School. Although they are in different classes, the review materials should be the same. There are still more than 20 days for the college entrance examination. Zhong Wang's grades are much better than yours. If you don't understand something, ask him more when you come back in the evening..."

Before Su's mother finished speaking, Tang Zhongwang suddenly interrupted Su's mother and interjected: "Dad, it's not so hot now. I went back to my room to review. I don't have any free time to waste on cats and dogs. I don't even have time. If you review more, you may get a few more points in the college entrance examination."

After saying that, Tang Zhongwang got up and went back to his room.But his words immediately made Su Lin angry. You, Tang Zhongwang, ridiculed me, Su Lin, and I don't care about you. My grades are indeed not as good as yours now. You have the capital to be proud of, but my parents are so humble, but you don't give my mother any face, and you talk about being a cat or a dog.Whether it was unbearable or not, Su Lin suddenly stood up: "Tang Zhongwang, stop here. Who do you think is a cat or a dog..."

"Who am I talking about? Who knows well? He doesn't study well and yet he is so confident. Haha, his voice is quite loud. He will be a good candidate for a part-time job in the future."

Tang Zhongwang didn't even look back. He seemed to be very disdainful to argue with Su Lin. He sneered a few times and said, "It's no big deal to have a loud voice. Su Lin, you have the guts to surpass me in tomorrow's mock exam. But in my opinion, I'm afraid you'll have to wait until the next life."

Originally, Su Lin was already quite heavy-handed by his parents, and he was ridiculed by Tang Zhongwang so much. He couldn't keep his composure. He immediately stood up and was about to teach Tang Zhongwang a lesson.

Unexpectedly, Su Lin's father gave Su Lin a stern scolding, "Go back to your room and read a book. What are you talking about? Your grades are not as good as others. Do you think you are reasonable?"

What Su Lin was most afraid of was his father. He had to listen to his father even if he didn't listen to anyone else, so he had no choice but to endure it. Looking at Tang Zhongwang's proud look, his teeth itched with hatred.

With a silent thought in his mind, Su Lin paused time, then quickly stepped forward and kicked Tang Zhongwang's calf hard, then returned to his position and released the time pause.

When time resumed, Tang Zhongwang suddenly felt as if his calf had been kicked. The severe pain caused him to stumble and fall to the ground.

Tang Zhongwang's father became nervous and quickly pulled up his son.

"I don't know, Dad, it feels like someone kicked my calf... maybe it's a cramp..." Tang Zhongwang looked at Su Lin and felt that Su Lin was causing trouble, but Su Lin was several steps away from him, so when he saw Su Lin gloating about his misfortune, he could only swallow his breath.

"This is called evil being punished, so that you can be proud of yourself."

Su Lin didn't forget to talk, and with this kick, he felt a little relieved.

At this moment, Ye Xingzhu's mother Liang Guizhu walked from the house to the yard, holding a schoolbag in her hand, and said to Su Lin: "Xiao Lin, is this your schoolbag? Why is it on the sofa at our house? It seems that you didn't come to our house this evening?"

"Oops! Why did I forget my schoolbag when I sneaked out earlier..."
